function render(){results.replaceChildren();out.hidden=true;const t=q.value.trim();if(!t)return;const rows=matches(kind,t);if(!rows.length)el(results,'p','لا توجد نتيجة');for(const n of rows)button(results,n,()=>{if(!allowed(kind==='customer'?'customers':'suppliers'))return toast('لا تملك الصلاحية');try{out.textContent=n+'\n'+balanceLabel(kind,balance(kind,n));out.hidden=false;results.replaceChildren();q.value=n;}catch(e){toast(e.message)}});}
